definitions.explanation: Having parts that are closely packed together.
Not known or meant to be known publicly.
Having a close or private connection.

notes:
MEANINGS:
1. Dense/Close: {密|みつ}な⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧ (dense forest)
2. Secret: ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧ (secret)
3. Close (relationship): ⟦{親密|しんみつ}→親密：14140_shinmitsu⟧ (intimate)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧ (secret)
・⟦{親密|しんみつ}→親密：14140_shinmitsu⟧ (intimate, close)
・⟦{緻密|ちみつ}→緻密：07915_chimitsu⟧ (precise, meticulous)
・⟦{密度|みつど}→密度：15137_mitsudo⟧ (density)
・⟦{密接|みっせつ}→密接：12289_missetsu⟧ (close, intimate)
・⟦{密輸|みつゆ}→密輸：20266_mitsuyu⟧ (smuggling)

COVID TERM:
⟦{三密|さんみつ}→三密：28366_sanmitsu⟧ (sanmitsu - the "three Cs") became widely used during the COVID-19 pandemic to describe situations to avoid:
・⟦{密閉|みっぺい}→密閉：19651_mippei⟧ (enclosed spaces)
・⟦{密集|みっしゅう}→密集：12342_misshuu⟧ (crowded places)
・⟦{密接|みっせつ}→密接：12289_missetsu⟧ (close contact)
